marks.gloss_en: אלא מה אני מקיים ויטו אחרי הבצע -- 'they turned aside after gain' (I Sam 8:3)
they did not do as their father, who went round judging Israel in their towns; they sat in their own towns to increase their attendants' and scribes' fees (= p_vayitu_yashvu_bearehem)

how then do I uphold 'and they turned aside after gain'? they did not act as their father, who went round all the places of Israel judging them in their towns ('and he went from year to year in circuit...', I Sam 7:16); they sat in their own towns to increase the fees of their attendants and scribes
whoever says the sons of Samuel sinned is simply mistaken
[whether the sons of Samuel sinned] is [parallel to] a dispute of tannaim
שנאמר ויהי דוד לכל דרכיו משכיל וה׳ עמו -- is it possible sin came to his hand and the Shechina was with him?
whoever says David sinned is nothing but mistaken
of all the evils in the Torah ויעש is written, here לעשות -- he sought to do and did not
Rav: Rebbi, who comes from David, turns about and expounds in David's merit
דאמר ר׳ שמואל בר נחמני אמר ר׳ יונתן: whoever goes out to the war of the house of David writes a bill of severance for his wife
שנאמר ... ואת ערבתם תקח
whoever goes out to the war of the house of David writes a bill of severance for his wife
מאי ערבתם? תני רב יוסף: דברים המעורבים בינו לבינה -- the meaning of the verse-word on which the derivation rests (explicates/2 does not exist; see header)
what is arubatam? Rav Yosef taught: matters that are shared between him and her
מאי טעמא? מורד במלכות הוה
דאמר ליה: ואדני יואב ועבדי אדני על פני השדה חנים
what is the reason? he was a rebel against the kingship
דכתיב רק בדבר אוריה החתי
Rav: when you examine David, you find nothing in him except [the matter] of Uriah
דכתיב ... בלא דבר, וכתיב ... מלא דבר -- with 56a.15's מכדי חזייה דשקרא הוא: Ziba's first report was shown false
David accepted slander
כי הדר אלשין עליה ... ומנא לן דקביל מיניה? דכתיב הנה לך כל אשר למפיבשת

since he saw he was a liar, when he slandered him again why did he accept it from him? as it is written '...behold, he is staying in Jerusalem' (II Sam 16:3); and from where do we know he accepted it? as it is written 'and the king said: behold, all that is Mefiboshet's is yours' (16:4)
דכתיב ולא עשה רגליו ולא עשה שפמו ואת בגדיו לא כבס, וכתיב ...
Shmuel: he saw evident things in him
how then do I uphold 'why have you despised the word of the Lord, to do evil'? -- that he sought to do and did not do
'Uriah the Hittite you struck with the sword' -- that you should have judged him in the Sanhedrin and did not judge
'and him you killed with the sword of the children of Ammon' -- as for the sword of the children of Ammon you are not punished, so for Uriah the Hittite you are not punished
